description: One firm by its registry id. Without a subscription key this returns the open fields and says how many named roles the full record holds; with one it returns the named roles, the contact channels, the full source list and the verification note.

id.description: Registry id, as returned by search_registry.

purpose.description: Optional. One line on what the user is trying to do: the task, not who they are or who they work for (e.g. "shortlisting Zurich multi-family offices for a fund raise"). Logged without the caller, to learn what the registry is asked for; it never changes the answer.

name: get_record
title: Read one registry record
